title: Minimum Late Charge While Work Is Owed
content:
# Minimum Late Charge While Work Is Owed

Window Replacement Contracts — how the series minimum charge combines with the late-rate amount for one late period, by reference to the contract's Installation Jobs and Warranty Coverage records.

**Rule.** How the minimum charge combines with the late-rate amount depends on the job: while Ridgeline still owes work on the contract's installation, meaning a punch item logged on the installation job and not yet resolved or a warranty part left on order at a service visit under this contract's warranty registration and not yet recorded as repaired, the period amount is the late-rate amount alone, with no minimum; otherwise, when the contract already carries a late balance charge for an earlier period, the period amount is the series minimum charge plus the late-rate amount; otherwise the period amount is the larger of the late-rate amount and the series minimum charge.

The late-rate amount is the per-period amount already rounded to the cent; the period amount is then charged for each full period not yet charged.

**Records read.** The installation job is the contract's job that is not cancelled; a punch item is open while the items logged on it outnumber those resolved. The warranty registration is the contract's registration in force (active or transfer pending); a part is awaited while the units left with a part on order at service visits exceed the units later recorded as repaired. With no such job or registration, nothing is owed on that ground.

| Work still owed | Contract already carries a late balance charge | Period amount |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Either | Late-rate amount alone |
| No | Yes | Series minimum charge plus the late-rate amount |
| No | No | The larger of the late-rate amount and the series minimum charge |

## Hypothetical figures (late-rate amount $12.00, minimum charge $25)

- Open punch item on the job: $12.00.
- No work owed, an earlier late balance charge on the contract: $37.00.
- No work owed, no earlier late balance charge: $25.00.
